subject: 56 Wareham Street Design and Demo Delay Lift
overview: The Commission approved a mitigated design and lifted the demolition delay for 56 Wareham Street while electing its 2025 officer slate and discussing a proposed preservation ordinance.

items.title: 56 Wareham Street Demolition Delay Lift
items.summary: Approved the mitigated design and lifted the demolition delay after the architect presented revisions that preserve the historic massing and integrate the existing structure into the new addition.

items.title: 140 Summer Street Demolition Inquiry
items.summary: Tabled the matter until a formal application and a new Form B survey are submitted for the property.

items.title: 2025 Slate of Officers
items.summary: Approved the 2025 officer slate, naming Jennifer Keenan as Chair, Kit Collins as First Vice Chair, and Ryan Hayward as Second Vice Chair to distribute administrative duties.

items.title: 2025 Meeting Schedule
items.summary: Approved the schedule of meeting dates for the 2025 calendar year.

items.title: Historic Preservation Ordinance Discussion
items.summary: Discussed drafting a new ordinance modeled on other municipalities to provide zoning relief for property owners who preserve historic structures while increasing density.

items.title: Property and Project Updates
items.summary: Reviewed various matters including the ongoing delay at 27 Allmont Street, an unauthorized porch removal at 4 Grove Street, and progress on archaeological surveys at Cross Street Cemetery and Thomas Brooks Park.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from November 2024.
